verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is itself a well-documented, typed, official Python SDK with multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), structured outputs, tools, and a CLI (clai), all backed by rich first-party docs. However, hands-on community reports cite real friction — broken streaming with some models, structured-output failures (esp. Azure OpenAI), and 'painful' lower-level APIs — indicating the SDK experience is not uniformly smooth across all providers. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks confirming consistent behavior across all supported model providers, and resolution evidence for the reported structured-output/streaming bugs.
